bootstrap.iid_class: test rows resampled i.i.d. inside each true class (as bootstrap_ci.py)
bootstrap.block5000: circular moving blocks of time-consecutive test rows inside each capture group (as revision_analyses.py part c); block shortened to n // min_blocks in small groups
bootstrap.joint: all runs of a condition (every model and seed) see the SAME resampled test rows, so seed means and model differences are resampled consistently (paired)
bootstrap.ci_test: percentile 95% CI of the seed mean (or difference of seed means) over test-row resamples; the seeds are fixed (conditional on the trained models)
bootstrap.ci_seeds_test: two-level: in every resample the model seeds are also drawn with replacement (n = 1 for XGBoost: equals ci_test); effects use the same drawn seeds in both conditions, model differences draw the seeds of each model independently
bootstrap.time_order: inside a capture group the global row order of the flagged sample is the time order; the random-split rows are put into that order with the rows stored by tree_seeds_proba.py (no block bootstrap for a random-split condition before such a run exists)

random/raw.row_order_block: time order (global rows of the tree_seeds npz)
